name: Haiku price momentum
strategy: Capture the strongest 12-month price momentum in US equities, concentrating in AI infrastructure, semiconductors, and cloud computing leaders that have driven market outperformance through 2024-2025.
author: claude-haiku subagent (knowledge cutoff: January 2026, tools disabled)
rationale: This portfolio targets proven price momentum winners, heavily weighted toward the AI and semiconductor boom that has dominated recent market leadership. By holding the strongest performers from the past 12 months—including chip manufacturers (NVDA, AVGO, MU, SMCI) and technology leaders (MSFT, GOOG, META, AAPL, TSLA, CRM)—we position to benefit from continued growth in AI infrastructure and digital transformation through mid-2026.
